latency_ms.definition: HTTP TestClient ingestion to committed response, alerting scenarios only; excludes operator context provisioning, network transit and observation delay

limitations: Synthetic experiments, not deployment efficacy or representative prevalence
Generated variants are correlated; nominal binomial intervals are not an independence claim
Any rejected/failed scenario invalidates headline metrics; no implicit benign prediction
No population FPR below 5% is established by these point estimates

alerts.explanation: PowerShell engine arguments contain an encoded-command option or inline download/decode marker; bounded parsing never executes content. Intent requires review. Encoded UTF-16LE command observed (30 bytes; SHA256 4565f15cde9b63a032d9f9320c91eb3faa2096aa2f2bba486d1b1b87653a0b84); never executed.
Unix shell command contains /dev/tcp/ redirection; investigate process context.
schtasks.exe requests task creation. This is a persistence-capable action, not proof of success or malicious intent.
useradd explicitly requests UID 0, creating a root-equivalent local identity if it succeeds.
An accepted sudo request names a supported shell executable as root. Authorization does not prove execution completion or an interactive session; compare against approved duties.
Connection to a globally routable IP on a configured uncommon port. Port alone does not establish C2.
